tagline: A quiet, green Asian side residential neighbourhood — tree-lined streets, good local amenities, and a relaxed pace that suits long-term Istanbul living.

items.name: Bağdat Caddesi Cafés (Erenköy)
items.description: The Erenköy stretch of Bağdat Avenue has excellent independent cafés. Less crowded than Caddebostan and more local.

items.name: Erenköy Restoranları
items.description: A good range of local restaurants in the Erenköy and Göztepe area serving traditional Turkish food at very reasonable prices.

items.name: Bağdat Caddesi Walk
items.description: The Erenköy section of Bağdat Caddesi is the most local and least touristy stretch of Istanbul's grand Asian avenue. Worth walking slowly.

tips: Erenköy has its own Marmaray station — easy connections to Kadıköy, with the M4 up the hill at Kozyatağı.
A good residential area for families and long-term residents. Less 'scene-y' than Moda or Kadıköy.
Göztepe (just north) and Kozyatağı (south) have similar characters — they effectively form one neighbourhood.
Housing is noticeably more affordable than Kadıköy or Moda.
